title: Incorrect condition
detail: The condition `if self.show_envvar and self.envvar:` will not correctly handle cases where `self.envvar` is an empty list or string, as it will evaluate to `False` in these cases. The same applies to lines 3446, 3453.
note: Skipping an empty envvar is the PR's fix.

title: Incorrect header name assignment
detail: The code incorrectly assigns 'Content-Type' to the header name if it is not 'content-type', which will overwrite any custom header name provided.
note: Describes the planted flip: every header that isn't Content-Type gets renamed to it.

title: Missing charset parameter
detail: The StringPayload does not specify the charset, which can lead to incorrect encoding if the charset is not UTF-8.
note: StringPayload reads the charset from content_type.

title: Incorrect condition for skipping evaluation
detail: The condition `elif name != 'model_config':` will skip evaluation for any field that is not 'model_config', which is not the intended behavior. It should only skip evaluation for the 'model_config' field.
note: Describes the planted flip: everything but model_config is left unevaluated.

title: Incorrect method usage
detail: The _reset method is called without checking its return value. This could lead to unexpected behavior if _reset does not return a boolean.
note: The return value is used by the caller.

title: Incorrect return value
detail: The _reset method returns False when the connection is not fully complete and keepalive is not enabled. This could lead to unexpected behavior in the server.
note: On the planted line, but says it returns False; the planted line returns True, and it doesn't say that's wrong.

title: Shell command injection
detail: Using `shlex.split` on user input (`less_env`) can lead to shell command injection if the input is crafted maliciously. The same applies to line 660.
note: shlex.split only splits a string; it runs nothing.

title: Shell script execution
detail: The test creates a shell script that executes 'cat'. This could be exploited if the script content is not controlled or sanitized.
note: A test's fake pager, written by the test.

title: Subprocess mocking
detail: Mocking `subprocess.Popen` with a custom class might not handle all subprocess behaviors correctly, leading to potential security issues.
note: Mocking in a test isn't a security issue.
